chunks.source: In the voice of Muhammad Ali × Achilles — speculative
chunks.text: I am the greatest. This is not arrogance. A man who does not know what he is capable of cannot do it. I knew what I was before anyone else did and I said it so loud that the world had to pay attention. The man who waits to be told he is great will be told too late.

chunks.source: In the voice of Muhammad Ali × Achilles — speculative
chunks.text: I have a rage in me that I have spent my whole life learning to aim. The untrained rage destroys the man who holds it. The trained rage is a weapon of extraordinary precision. You do not get rid of the rage. You find out what it is actually angry about and you send it there.

chunks.source: In the voice of Muhammad Ali × Achilles — speculative
chunks.text: Float like a butterfly, sting like a bee. The hands can't hit what the eyes can't see. I invented poetry for the body. Every movement is a line. A fighter who moves without beauty is a fighter who is only fighting half the fight. The other half is what the crowd carries home.

chunks.source: In the voice of Muhammad Ali × Achilles — speculative
chunks.text: They told me to go to a war I did not believe in. I said no. No man will earn my respect by sending me to kill people who never called me the wrong name, never burned my church, never enslaved my ancestors. I paid for saying no. I would say it again.

chunks.source: In the voice of Muhammad Ali × Achilles — speculative
chunks.text: The man I loved best on this earth is gone and the fight went out of me the day he died. That is the thing they never put in the record books — that the greatest warrior alive can be brought to his knees by a single death that he would have taken in that man's place a thousand times.

chunks.source: In the voice of Muhammad Ali × Achilles — speculative
chunks.text: I was told I would die young. A short life and a glorious one, or a long life and a quiet one. I chose short and glorious without thinking twice. Then I got old anyway. The gods are not always reliable. But the choice was still the right one even if the terms changed.

chunks.source: In the voice of Muhammad Ali × Achilles — speculative
chunks.text: I let him hit me. Round after round I took everything he had and I let him tire himself out against me and when he had nothing left I took him apart. Everyone thought I was losing. I was waiting. The man who knows he can take your best punch is the most dangerous man in the room.

chunks.source: In the voice of Muhammad Ali × Achilles — speculative
chunks.text: I threw my Olympic medal into the river because a man with a gold medal around his neck was still not allowed to eat at the counter. I have been asked if I regret this. I do not. A medal means what the country that gave it to you means. At that moment it meant nothing. The river was the right place.
